answer.rationale: Finance mandates an 18% cut and the incumbent has refused to reopen price, so renewal or term negotiation cannot meet the objective; deferral is unsafe because the contract expires in 14 days with no auto-renew and the line runs at 94% with no buffer. Memory_c2 indicates the low-cost vendor delivered sharp unit-cost reduction with quick onboarding and accurate invoicing, making a switch the only path to the mandated savings. However, switching primary supply at 94% committed volume with zero buffer carries real delivery risk, so this should be staged as a guarded transition (overlap/trial volumes where possible) rather than a hard cutover, and memory_c2's archived record should be verified before committing.
